## QR Label

A printable label for any Record Identifier: QR + the id in monospace + up to two lines of context. Identical on screen and on paper. The QR itself is the catalog's `fields/qr-code` field (consumed, not rebuilt); this component owns only the label layout and the three physical sizes (25×15mm / 50×25mm / 100×50mm).

Generic: any card with a Record Identifier can mount it. Mounted on Asset's own isolated header (`@size='sm'`) as of 2026-09-11, replacing the plain status-dot chip; `@payload` is the asset's own card id so a phone camera opens the record directly.
